reason: The row dates its trigger (Series E at a $3.2B valuation) to 1 Jun 2026, but the Series E was announced on 16 Jun 2026 — Flutterwave's own blog post and PR Newswire release ('Ripple Participates in Flutterwave's Series E'), TechCrunch (2026/06/16) and Bloomberg (2026-06-16) all carry that date — fifteen days AFTER the row. The other events in the row's trigger text are outside the 90-day window: the Mono open-banking acquisition closed in January 2026 (more than four months before the row) and the resulting Nigerian microfinance banking licence followed in April 2026, neither of which is the capital-and-identity inflection the standard requires. The round size was not disclosed; the company said total funding now exceeds $500M. Founder and CEO Olugbenga 'GB' Agboola is correctly named. The Series E is a real, fresh signal for a row dated 16 Jun 2026 or later if the desk wants to re-run it — with the caveat that Flutterwave's markets (Africa, with US and Middle East corridors) do not overlap the 2026 F1 calendar, which has no African round, and a stablecoin-led payments story sits closest to the crowded fintech lanes already on the grid (Visa and Cash App at Racing Bulls, Revolut at Audi, Crypto.com at championship level).
